jobDescription: Ferrovia Data sells a geospatial data API to logistics and property software companies. The Product Manager for the developer API writes specifications with the platform engineers, runs early-access programmes with customers, takes features to general availability through the release process with a post-launch review, prepares developer-facing launch material and works with the commercial team on how features are packaged and priced. The API serves around 400 customer accounts, and releases follow a release review with engineering, support and developer relations.
requirements: Writes API specifications with engineering, including error and versioning behaviour.
Has taken an API feature to general availability in production through a release process, with a post-launch review.
Prices or packages API features with the commercial team.

evidence.text: Product Manager, Tidewater APIs, March 2021 to July 2024: wrote the specification for per-key rate limiting with two platform engineers, including the 429 response format, retry headers and versioning rules, reviewed by the architecture group.
Ran a six-week early-access programme for rate limiting with nine customers on a separate preview endpoint, holding weekly feedback calls and logging requests on the product board.

Took rate limiting to general availability on all production endpoints on 21 February 2024 after the release review signed off the launch checklist, and chaired the post-launch review three weeks later with engineering and support.

Wrote the changelog entry, the migration guide and the customer email announcing rate limiting; developer relations reviewed each before publication, and the API reference pages were updated to match.
Supplied per-plan usage data to the commercial team, which then set the limits attached to each pricing tier, and wrote the internal FAQ for the sales team.

Work sample: the post-launch review for rate limiting, including the signed launch checklist, the production release date of 21 February 2024, counts of 429 responses by plan for the first three weeks and two follow-up actions agreed with engineering, both closed within a month.
HR verification note: the title Product Manager and the employment dates March 2021 to July 2024 at Tidewater APIs were checked against the employer's written verification.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate can attend the final interview in the week of 3 November and would like to meet the engineering lead.
